independentLayers.description: Reference numbers for the composite row: edge, padding, gap and radius, and its 7u toggles (height, inset, radius).

intent: Press one or several of a set of related toggles, such as text formatting or a view filter, with the pressed values owned by the group

properties.description: Comma-separated values of the pressed toggles (a toggle value is its value attribute, else its index). Setting it presses and releases the toggles without a change event.
The first value, applied once at connect when no value attribute is present (Base UI defaultValue). Without either, the toggles pressed / default-pressed seed it.
Several toggles may be pressed; otherwise pressing one releases the others and only the first seeded toggle is pressed.
Every toggle is disabled (aria-disabled, data-disabled) and leaves the tab order.
horizontal (default) or vertical: the toggle layout and which arrow keys move focus (Left / Right, mirrored in RTL; Up / Down).

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Sets the unit u (px) for this element and its subtree: one of the SIZES steps 2…12 (data-size is the same input). Lengths scale from u; type follows 10px + u.

attributes.name: inset
attributes.description: none: attached. The edge is the border alone and children touch the edge and each other with no gap and no curvature (the first and last keep the container's outer corners; neighbours split by a 1px border-role divider). Range and switch: the thumb fills the track and takes its radius. Default: inset.

events.name: change
events.detail: { value: string[], reason: 'none', event: Event } (Base UI ToggleGroup onValueChange)
events.trigger: a toggle is pressed (click, Enter or Space); the toggle's own change does not leave the group; preventDefault keeps every toggle as it is

keyboard.action: press or release it (single mode: pressing releases the others)
move focus to the next / previous enabled toggle, wrapping; Left / Right flip in RTL
move focus to the first / last enabled toggle

content.children: ui-toggle children, each with a value (else its index). Other children are left as they are and take no part in the value.

constraints: The group owns its toggles' pressed state: change the group's value, not a toggle's pressed, from script. A toggle's change is answered by the group and does not propagate; the group fires its own change.
Without value or default-value, the toggles' pressed / default-pressed attributes seed the first value (only the first pressed one in single mode).
Single mode allows no toggle pressed: pressing the pressed toggle releases it (Base UI ToggleGroup).
Roving focus: one toggle is the tab stop (the last focused, else the first pressed, else the first enabled); arrow keys only move focus, Enter or Space presses.
No form value: a toggle group is not form-associated (Base UI ToggleGroup); submit its value from application state.
React: ToggleGroup with Toggle children that have a value; the group sets the buttons' tabIndex after each render.

avoidWhen.when: Choosing exactly one of a few options that must always have a value, submitted with a form.
avoidWhen.reason: A segmented control is a single-select listbox with a form value and always one selection.

avoidWhen.when: Several independent settings, each on or off, submitted with a form.
avoidWhen.reason: Checkboxes in a group own form values and a parent checkbox.

avoidWhen.when: Switching between peer views with panels.
avoidWhen.reason: Tabs tie each label to its panel (role=tab, aria-controls).

props: render?: RenderProp // Replace the part's element (Base UI render): an element (the part's props merge into it) or `(props, state) => element`. The recipe class and data-* stay on whatever renders.
className?: string | ((state: PartState) => string | undefined) // Author class, or a function of the part's state (Base UI className); added after the recipe class.
value?: string[] // Controlled pressed toggle values.
defaultValue?: string[] = [] // Pressed toggle values at first render (uncontrolled).
onValueChange?: (value: string[], details: ChangeDetails) => void // Called when a press changes the pressed toggles, with Base UI's details ({ reason: 'none', event }).
multiple?: boolean = false // Several toggles may be pressed at once (default: pressing one releases the others).
disabled?: boolean = false // Every toggle ignores presses.
orientation?: 'horizontal' | 'vertical' = 'horizontal' // horizontal (default): Left / Right move focus; vertical: Up / Down.
size?: number // Unit u in px; the row is 8u with 7u toggles.
inset?: 'none' // inset="none": attached. Children touch the edge and each other with no curvature (outer corners follow the container); thumbs fill the track.
